newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS TO BOUNCE BUT 134.73 SUPPORT BECKONS.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS TO BOUNCE BUT 134.73 SUPPORT BECKONS.

text.p: September BTP futures will continue their overall downward trend but may be in for some corrective bounce up on Thursday, technical anlaysts said.

"Short-term BTPs are negative, medium term they're corrective, long term they're neutral to positive. We are still in uncertain territory and haven't broken the broad cycle," said Anil Patel, technical analyst at Nomura International in London.
He said for this session the contract could test resistance at 136.27 and above there at 136.42 before heading lower towards 134.73 support and beyond.
At 0839 GMT, September BTP futures were up 0.18 at 135.90.
Patel said 134.73, Wednesday's low, nearly coincided with the July 3 low at 134.77 and suggested BTPs were trying to base at this level.
On the way down he said 135.35, 33 would act as a cushioning level.
Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking here also noted support in that region.
"That will probably contain it for today," Ostwald said. "If we were to break that level then we would be heading for 134.22, the June 24 high."
To the upside, Ostwald said Wednesday's action looked like a corrective bounce and could be taken a bit furhter before turning down.
He noted resistance around 136.15 and said above there the next big level was 136.70.
"I'm not convinced we are going to get that far. Once we get to around 136.15 to 136.25 it may start petering out," he said.
At the short end, September Eurolira futures were at 93.22, up one basis point on the day.
